title: The $11B Voice That Bills Per Hello
desc: ElevenLabs hit $11B and $330M ARR by selling hello at 75ms. Per character billing, no phoneme cache and the 1M RPS voice bill that proves hello should be cached.

title: The $6.6B Preview Button That Reinstalls the Internet
desc: Lovable hit $6.6B by turning prompts into apps. Teardown of preview sandboxes, repeated npm installs and 1B tokens per minute that could have reused a cache.

title: The Serverless Postgres That Was Not Serverless at 3 AM
desc: Supabase runs 2M Postgres databases behind one pooling promise. Supavisor, transaction mode, RLS tax and the 1M RPS math that proves pooling is a cost control.

title: The Ledger That Cannot Blink
desc: Stripe processed $1.4 trillion without double charging anything. Idempotency keys, double entry ledger and webhook storms at 1M RPS.

title: 18 Trillion Messages a Day. Half of Them Could Have Waited.
desc: Roblox routes 18 trillion Kafka messages daily through one platform that treats urgent matchmaking like patient analytics. Teardown of the tiers plus a cheaper shape.

title: Cursor and Claude Code Postmortem: The Token Meter Is the Real Pair Programmer
desc: A forensic teardown of token limits, context rot, compaction cliffs, productivity math and the fixes vendors keep postponing.

title: Perplexity Postmortem: The Answer Engine That Pays for Every Question Twice
desc: A forensic teardown of RAG retrieval, KV cache flaws, prefill tax, 780M monthly queries, and the cost difference at 1M events per second.

title: Simultaneous AI Model Outage: The Single Point We All Ignored
desc: Four frontier providers dark inside the same four-hour window. The shared layer beneath them plus the failure math behind it.

title: Replit Agent Postmortem: The Day the Demo Became Production
desc: A deep teardown of prompt-to-production software, sandbox execution, agent retries, deployment risk and the cost difference at 1M events per second.

title: Vercel Fluid Compute: The Serverless Bill Was Waiting for a Response
desc: A forensic teardown of Fluid Compute, compute-resolver, concurrency, cold starts, AI Gateway waiting time, a normalized 1M RPS cost model and the levers that make serverless economics less theatrical.

title: Figma's Multiplayer Editor: The Server That Decides Who Wins
desc: A forensic teardown of Figma's WebSocket collaboration engine, server-authoritative conflict resolution, Rust rewrite, per-document isolation, modeled 65k RPS and the cost controls behind an always-live canvas.

title: The Workspace That Ate the Warehouse
desc: A forensic teardown of Notion's 200-billion-block data platform: 480 logical shards, CDC, Kafka, Hudi, vector search, a modeled 100k RPS peak and the cost controls that can stop a flexible product from becoming an infrastructure furnace.

title: Rethinking Control Planes: Cell-Based Architectures for Zero-Blast Radius
desc: An analysis of global sync failures in high-availability systems and why breaking control planes into autonomous regional Raft-backed cells prevents cascading cloud outages.
